+"""
+JARVIS v20 - Model Monitoring & Drift Detection
+================================================
+
+Monitoraggio continuo per:
+- Data drift (feature distribution shifts)
+- Concept drift (model performance degradation)
+- Data quality checks
+- Feature importance stability
+- Prediction distribution monitoring
+- Alerting system
+
+Install: pip install evidently (per report avanzati)
+         pip install scipy (per statistical tests)
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import warnings
+import json
+import time
+from collections import deque
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union
+
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+
+try:
+    from scipy import stats
+    from scipy.stats import ks_2samp, chi2_contingency, wasserstein_distance
+    HAS_SCIPY = True
+except ImportError:
+    HAS_SCIPY = False
+
+try:
+    from evidently.report import Report
+    from evidently.metric_preset import DataDriftPreset, DataQualityPreset, TargetDriftPreset
+    from evidently.metrics import ColumnDriftMetric, DatasetDriftMetric, DatasetMissingValuesMetric
+    HAS_EVIDENTLY = True
+except ImportError:
+    HAS_EVIDENTLY = False
+
+from .config import Settings
+
+warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
+
+
+@dataclass
+class MonitoringConfig:
+    """Configurazione monitoring."""
+    # Reference window
+    reference_window_days: int = 30
+    monitoring_window_days: int = 7
+    
+    # Drift thresholds
+    drift_threshold: float = 0.05  # p-value per KS test
+    psi_threshold: float = 0.2     # Population Stability Index
+    wasserstein_threshold: float = 0.1
+    
+    # Data quality
+    missing_threshold: float = 0.05
+    outlier_std_threshold: float = 4.0
+    
+    # Performance
+    min_samples_for_drift: int = 100
+    performance_window: int = 100
+    performance_threshold: float = 0.1  # degradation threshold
+    
+    # Alerting
+    alert_cooldown_hours: int = 24
+    alert_channels: List[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: ["log", "telegram"])
+    
+    # Feature groups
+    numerical_features: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    categorical_features: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    target_column: str = "target"
+    prediction_column: str = "prediction"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class DriftAlert:
+    """Alert per drift detection."""
+    timestamp: datetime
+    feature: str
+    drift_type: str  # "data_drift", "concept_drift", "data_quality"
+    severity: str    # "low", "medium", "high", "critical"
+    metric_value: float
+    threshold: float
+    message: str
+    details: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+
+class DataDriftDetector:
+    """
+    Rileva data drift usando multiple metriche:
+    - KS test (Kolmogorov-Smirnov)
+    - PSI (Population Stability Index)
+    - Wasserstein distance
+    - Chi-square per categorical
+    """
+    
+    def __init__(self, config: MonitoringConfig):
+        self.config = config
+        self.reference_data: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None
+        self.feature_stats: Dict[str, Dict] = {}
+        self.alert_history: List[DriftAlert] = []
+    
+    def set_reference(self, data: pd.DataFrame):
+        """Imposta dataset di riferimento (training/validation)."""
+        self.reference_data = data.copy()
+        self._compute_reference_stats()
+    
+    def _compute_reference_stats(self):
+        """Calcola statistiche di riferimento per ogni feature."""
+        if self.reference_data is None:
+            return
+        
+        for col in self.reference_data.columns:
+            if col in [self.config.target_column, self.config.prediction_column]:
+                continue
+            
+            series = self.reference_data[col].dropna()
+            
+            if len(series) == 0:
+                continue
+            
+            if series.dtype in ['object', 'category']:
+                # Categorical
+                value_counts = series.value_counts(normalize=True)
+                self.feature_stats[col] = {
+                    "type": "categorical",
+                    "distribution": value_counts.to_dict(),
+                    "n_unique": series.nunique(),
+                    "most_frequent": value_counts.index[0] if len(value_counts) > 0 else None,
+                }
+            else:
+                # Numerical
+                self.feature_stats[col] = {
+                    "type": "numerical",
+                    "mean": float(series.mean()),
+                    "std": float(series.std()),
+                    "min": float(series.min()),
+                    "max": float(series.max()),
+                    "quantiles": {
+                        "0.01": float(series.quantile(0.01)),
+                        "0.05": float(series.quantile(0.05)),
+                        "0.25": float(series.quantile(0.25)),
+                        "0.50": float(series.quantile(0.50)),
+                        "0.75": float(series.quantile(0.75)),
+                        "0.95": float(series.quantile(0.95)),
+                        "0.99": float(series.quantile(0.99)),
+                    },
+                    "skew": float(series.skew()),
+                    "kurtosis": float(series.kurtosis()),
+                }
+    
+    def check_drift(self, current_data: pd.DataFrame) -> List[DriftAlert]:
+        """Controlla drift su dati correnti."""
+        alerts = []
+        
+        if self.reference_data is None:
+            return alerts
+        
+        for col in self.reference_data.columns:
+            if col in [self.config.target_column, self.config.prediction_column]:
+                continue
+            
+            if col not in current_data.columns:
+                alerts.append(DriftAlert(
+                    timestamp=datetime.now(),
+                    feature=col,
+                    drift_type="data_quality",
+                    severity="high",
+                    metric_value=0,
+                    threshold=1,
+                    message=f"Feature {col} mancante nei dati correnti",
+                    details={"missing_feature": col}
+                ))
+                continue
+            
+            ref_series = self.reference_data[col].dropna()
+            cur_series = current_data[col].dropna()
+            
+            if len(cur_series) < self.config.min_samples_for_drift:
+                continue
+            
+            # Skip if reference has too few samples
+            if len(ref_series) < self.config.min_samples_for_drift:
+                continue
+            
+            if col in self.feature_stats:
+                stat = self.feature_stats[col]
+                
+                if stat["type"] == "numerical":
+                    alerts.extend(self._check_numerical_drift(col, ref_series, cur_series, stat))
+                else:
+                    alerts.extend(self._check_categorical_drift(col, ref_series, cur_series, stat))
+        
+        # Filtra alert per cooldown
+        filtered_alerts = self._filter_alerts(alerts)
+        self.alert_history.extend(filtered_alerts)
+        
+        return filtered_alerts
+    
+    def _check_numerical_drift(self, col: str, ref: pd.Series, cur: pd.Series, stat: Dict) -> List[DriftAlert]:
+        """Controlla drift per feature numeriche."""
+        alerts = []
+        
+        # 1. KS Test
+        if HAS_SCIPY and len(ref) > 10 and len(cur) > 10:
+            try:
+                ks_stat, p_value = ks_2samp(ref, cur)
+                if p_value < self.config.drift_threshold:
+                    alerts.append(DriftAlert(
+                        timestamp=datetime.now(),
+                        feature=col,
+                        drift_type="data_drift",
+                        severity="high" if p_value < 0.001 else "medium",
+                        metric_value=p_value,
+                        threshold=self.config.drift_threshold,
+                        message=f"KS test drift detected for {col}: p-value={p_value:.4f}",
+                        details={"ks_statistic": float(ks_stat), "p_value": float(p_value)}
+                    ))
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+        
+        # 2. PSI (Population Stability Index)
+        psi = self._calculate_psi(ref, cur)
+        if psi > self.config.psi_threshold:
+            alerts.append(DriftAlert(
+                timestamp=datetime.now(),
+                feature=col,
+                drift_type="data_drift",
+                severity="high" if psi > 0.5 else "medium",
+                metric_value=psi,
+                threshold=self.config.psi_threshold,
+                message=f"PSI drift detected for {col}: PSI={psi:.4f}",
+                details={"psi": psi}
+            ))
+        
+        # 3. Wasserstein Distance
+        if HAS_SCIPY:
+            try:
+                wdist = wasserstein_distance(ref, cur)
+                # Normalizza per scale
+                ref_range = stat["max"] - stat["min"]
+                if ref_range > 0:
+                    norm_wdist = wdist / ref_range
+                    if norm_wdist > self.config.wasserstein_threshold:
+                        alerts.append(DriftAlert(
+                            timestamp=datetime.now(),
+                            feature=col,
+                            drift_type="data_drift",
+                            severity="medium",
+                            metric_value=norm_wdist,
+                            threshold=self.config.wasserstein_threshold,
+                            message=f"Wasserstein drift for {col}: {norm_wdist:.4f}",
+                            details={"wasserstein": float(wdist), "normalized": norm_wdist}
+                        ))
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+        
+        # 4. Mean/Std shift
+        cur_mean = cur.mean()
+        cur_std = cur.std()
+        ref_mean = stat["mean"]
+        ref_std = stat["std"]
+        
+        if ref_std > 0:
+            mean_shift = abs(cur_mean - ref_mean) / ref_std
+            if mean_shift > 3:  # 3 sigma shift
+                alerts.append(DriftAlert(
+                    timestamp=datetime.now(),
+                    feature=col,
+                    drift_type="data_drift",
+                    severity="high" if mean_shift > 5 else "medium",
+                    metric_value=mean_shift,
+                    threshold=3.0,
+                    message=f"Mean shift for {col}: {mean_shift:.2f} sigma",
+                    details={"current_mean": cur_mean, "reference_mean": ref_mean, "shift_sigma": mean_shift}
+                ))
+        
+        if ref_std > 0:
+            std_ratio = cur_std / ref_std
+            if std_ratio > 2 or std_ratio < 0.5:
+                alerts.append(DriftAlert(
+                    timestamp=datetime.now(),
+                    feature=col,
+                    drift_type="data_drift",
+                    severity="medium",
+                    metric_value=std_ratio,
+                    threshold=2.0,
+                    message=f"Std deviation change for {col}: ratio={std_ratio:.2f}",
+                    details={"current_std": cur_std, "reference_std": ref_std, "ratio": std_ratio}
+                ))
+        
+        return alerts
+    
+    def _check_categorical_drift(self, col: str, ref: pd.Series, cur: pd.Series, stat: Dict) -> List[DriftAlert]:
+        """Controlla drift per feature categoriche."""
+        alerts = []
+        
+        ref_dist = pd.Series(stat["distribution"])
+        cur_dist = cur.value_counts(normalize=True)
+        
+        # Allinea categorie
+        all_cats = set(ref_dist.index) | set(cur_dist.index)
+        ref_aligned = ref_dist.reindex(all_cats, fill_value=0)
+        cur_aligned = cur_dist.reindex(all_cats, fill_value=0)
+        
+        # Chi-square test
+        if HAS_SCIPY:
+            try:
+                # Converti a counts
+                ref_counts = ref.value_counts().reindex(all_cats, fill_value=1)
+                cur_counts = cur.value_counts().reindex(all_cats, fill_value=1)
+                
+                chi2, p_value, _, _ = chi2_contingency([ref_counts, cur_counts])
+                if p_value < self.config.drift_threshold:
+                    return [DriftAlert(
+                        timestamp=datetime.now(),
+                        feature=col,
+                        drift_type="data_drift",
+                        severity="high" if p_value < 0.001 else "medium",
+                        metric_value=p_value,
+                        threshold=self.config.drift_threshold,
+                        message=f"Categorical drift (Chi2) for {col}: p-value={p_value:.4f}",
+                        details={"chi2": float(chi2), "p_value": float(p_value)}
+                    )]
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+        
+        # JS Divergence (simmetrica)
+        try:
+            from scipy.special import rel_entr
+            js_div = 0.5 * sum(rel_entr(ref_aligned, (ref_aligned + cur_aligned) / 2)) + \
+                     0.5 * sum(rel_entr(cur_aligned, (ref_aligned + cur_aligned) / 2))
+            
+            if js_div > 0.1:  # threshold JS divergence
+                alerts.append(DriftAlert(
+                    timestamp=datetime.now(),
+                    feature=col,
+                    drift_type="data_drift",
+                    severity="medium" if js_div < 0.5 else "high",
+                    metric_value=js_div,
+                    threshold=0.1,
+                    message=f"JS Divergence drift for {col}: {js_div:.4f}",
+                    details={"js_divergence": float(js_div)}
+                ))
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+        
+        return alerts
+    
+    def _calculate_psi(self, ref: pd.Series, cur: pd.Series, bins: int = 10) -> float:
+        """Calcola Population Stability Index."""
+        try:
+            # Crea bins basati su quantili di riferimento
+            quantiles = np.linspace(0, 1, bins + 1)
+            bin_edges = ref.quantile(quantiles).unique()
+            
+            if len(bin_edges) < 2:
+                return 0.0
+            
+            # Histogram
+            ref_hist, _ = np.histogram(ref, bins=bin_edges, density=True)
+            cur_hist, _ = np.histogram(cur, bins=bin_edges, density=True)
+            
+            # Normalizza
+            ref_hist = ref_hist / (ref_hist.sum() + 1e-10)
+            cur_hist = cur_hist / (cur_hist.sum() + 1e-10)
+            
+            # PSI = sum((cur - ref) * ln(cur/ref))
+            psi = np.sum((cur_hist - ref_hist) * np.log((cur_hist + 1e-10) / (ref_hist + 1e-10)))
+            return float(psi)
+        except Exception:
+            return 0.0
+    
+    def _filter_alerts(self, alerts: List[DriftAlert]) -> List[DriftAlert]:
+        """Filtra alert per cooldown."""
+        filtered = []
+        now = datetime.now()
+        cooldown = timedelta(hours=self.config.alert_cooldown_hours)
+        
+        for alert in alerts:
+            # Controlla se alert simile recente
+            recent = [a for a in self.alert_history 
+                     if a.feature == alert.feature 
+                     and a.drift_type == alert.drift_type
+                     and (now - a.timestamp) < cooldown]
+            
+            if not recent:
+                filtered.append(alert)
+        
+        return filtered
+    
+    def get_drift_summary(self) -> Dict:
+        """Riassunto stato drift."""
+        if not self.alert_history:
+            return {"status": "no_drift", "alerts_count": 0}
+        
+        recent_alerts = [a for a in self.alert_history 
+                        if (datetime.now() - a.timestamp) < timedelta(hours=24)]
+        
+        by_type = {}
+        by_severity = {}
+        for alert in recent_alerts:
+            by_type[alert.drift_type] = by_type.get(alert.drift_type, 0) + 1
+            by_severity[alert.severity] = by_severity.get(alert.severity, 0) + 1
+        
+        return {
+            "status": "drift_detected" if recent_alerts else "stable",
+            "alerts_24h": len(recent_alerts),
+            "by_type": by_type,
+            "by_severity": by_severity,
+            "latest_alert": recent_alerts[-1].message if recent_alerts else None,
+        }
+

+class ConceptDriftDetector:
+    """
+    Rileva concept drift monitorando performance del modello.
+    """
+    
+    def __init__(self, config: MonitoringConfig):
+        self.config = config
+        self.performance_history: deque = deque(maxlen=config.performance_window)
+        self.baseline_performance: Optional[float] = None
+        self.alert_history: List[DriftAlert] = []
+    
+    def update_performance(self, metric_name: str, value: float, timestamp: datetime = None):
+        """Aggiorna metrica performance."""
+        ts = timestamp or datetime.now()
+        self.performance_history.append({
+            "timestamp": ts,
+            "metric": metric_name,
+            "value": value,
+        })
+        
+        # Imposta baseline se prima volta
+        if self.baseline_performance is None:
+            self.baseline_performance = value
+    
+    def check_concept_drift(self) -> List[DriftAlert]:
+        """Controlla se performance degradato significativamente."""
+        alerts = []
+        
+        if len(self.performance_history) < 20:
+            return alerts
+        
+        if self.baseline_performance is None:
+            return alerts
+        
+        # Calcola performance recente (ultimi N campioni)
+        recent = list(self.performance_history)[-20:]
+        recent_values = [p["value"] for p in recent]
+        recent_mean = np.mean(recent_values)
+        recent_std = np.std(recent_values)
+        
+        # Degradation relativa
+        if self.baseline_performance != 0:
+            degradation = (self.baseline_performance - recent_mean) / abs(self.baseline_performance)
+        else:
+            degradation = 0
+        
+        # Controlla soglia
+        if degradation > self.config.performance_threshold:
+            alerts.append(DriftAlert(
+                timestamp=datetime.now(),
+                feature="model_performance",
+                drift_type="concept_drift",
+                severity="high" if degradation > self.config.performance_threshold * 2 else "medium",
+                metric_value=degradation,
+                threshold=self.config.performance_threshold,
+                message=f"Model performance degradation: {degradation:.2%} (baseline: {self.baseline_performance:.4f}, recent: {recent_mean:.4f})",
+                details={
+                    "baseline": self.baseline_performance,
+                    "recent_mean": recent_mean,
+                    "degradation_pct": degradation,
+                    "recent_std": recent_std,
+                }
+            ))
+        
+        # Controlla anche volatilità performance
+        if len(self.performance_history) >= 50:
+            all_values = [p["value"] for p in self.performance_history]
+            overall_std = np.std(all_values)
+            recent_std_val = np.std(recent_values)
+            
+            if overall_std > 0 and recent_std_val / overall_std > 2:
+                alerts.append(DriftAlert(
+                    timestamp=datetime.now(),
+                    feature="model_performance_volatility",
+                    drift_type="concept_drift",
+                    severity="medium",
+                    metric_value=recent_std_val / overall_std,
+                    threshold=2.0,
+                    message=f"Performance volatility increased: {recent_std_val/overall_std:.2f}x",
+                    details={"overall_std": overall_std, "recent_std": recent_std_val}
+                ))
+        
+        return alerts
+    
+    def reset_baseline(self, new_baseline: float = None):
+        """Reset baseline (es. dopo retraining)."""
+        if new_baseline is not None:
+            self.baseline_performance = new_baseline
+        elif len(self.performance_history) >= 20:
+            recent = list(self.performance_history)[-20:]
+            self.baseline_performance = np.mean([p["value"] for p in recent])
+

+class DataQualityMonitor:
+    """
+    Monitora qualità dati in tempo reale.
+    """
+    
+    def __init__(self, config: MonitoringConfig):
+        self.config = config
+        self.alert_history: List[DriftAlert] = []
+    
+    def check_data_quality(self, data: pd.DataFrame) -> List[DriftAlert]:
+        """Controlla qualità dati."""
+        alerts = []
+        
+        # 1. Missing values
+        for col in data.columns:
+            missing_pct = data[col].isnull().mean()
+            if missing_pct > self.config.missing_threshold:
+                alerts.append(DriftAlert(
+                    timestamp=datetime.now(),
+                    feature=col,
+                    drift_type="data_quality",
+                    severity="high" if missing_pct > 0.5 else "medium",
+                    metric_value=missing_pct,
+                    threshold=self.config.missing_threshold,
+                    message=f"High missing values in {col}: {missing_pct:.2%}",
+                    details={"missing_count": int(data[col].isnull().sum()), "total": len(data)}
+                ))
+        
+        # 2. Outliers (numerical)
+        for col in data.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns:
+            series = data[col].dropna()
+            if len(series) < 10:
+                continue
+            
+            mean = series.mean()
+            std = series.std()
+            if std > 0:
+                z_scores = np.abs((series - series.mean()) / series.std())
+                outliers = (z_scores > self.config.outlier_std_threshold).sum()
+                outlier_pct = outliers / len(series)
+                
+                if outlier_pct > 0.05:  # >5% outliers
+                    alerts.append(DriftAlert(
+                        timestamp=datetime.now(),
+                        feature=col,
+                        drift_type="data_quality",
+                        severity="medium",
+                        metric_value=outlier_pct,
+                        threshold=0.05,
+                        message=f"High outlier rate in {col}: {outlier_pct:.2%}",
+                        details={"outlier_count": int(outliers), "threshold_std": self.config.outlier_std_threshold}
+                    ))
+        
+        # 3. Constant features
+        for col in data.columns:
+            if data[col].nunique() <= 1:
+                alerts.append(DriftAlert(
+                    timestamp=datetime.now(),
+                    feature=col,
+                    drift_type="data_quality",
+                    severity="high",
+                    metric_value=data[col].nunique(),
+                    threshold=1,
+                    message=f"Constant feature detected: {col}",
+                    details={"unique_values": int(data[col].nunique())}
+                ))
+        
+        # 4. Duplicate rows
+        dup_count = data.duplicated().sum()
+        if dup_count > 0:
+            alerts.append(DriftAlert(
+                timestamp=datetime.now(),
+                feature="__dataset__",
+                drift_type="data_quality",
+                severity="low",
+                metric_value=dup_count / len(data),
+                threshold=0,
+                message=f"Duplicate rows detected: {dup_count}",
+                details={"duplicate_count": int(dup_count)}
+            ))
+        
+        return alerts
+

+class ModelMonitor:
+    """
+    Monitor completo che combina tutti i detector.
+    """
+    
+    def __init__(self, config: Optional[MonitoringConfig] = None):
+        self.config = config or MonitoringConfig()
+        self.data_drift = DataDriftDetector(self.config)
+        self.concept_drift = ConceptDriftDetector(self.config)
+        self.data_quality = DataQualityMonitor(self.config)
+        
+        self.all_alerts: List[DriftAlert] = []
+        self.monitoring_active = False
+    
+    def set_reference(self, reference_data: pd.DataFrame):
+        """Imposta dati di riferimento."""
+        self.data_drift.set_reference(reference_data)
+        self.monitoring_active = True
+    
+    def monitor_batch(
+        self,
+        current_data: pd.DataFrame,
+        predictions: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
+        targets: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
+        performance_metrics: Dict[str, float] = None,
+    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """Monitora un batch di dati."""
+        
+        all_alerts = []
+        
+        # 1. Data quality
+        quality_alerts = self.data_quality.check_data_quality(current_data)
+        all_alerts.extend(quality_alerts)
+        
+        # 2. Data drift
+        drift_alerts = self.data_drift.check_drift(current_data)
+        all_alerts.extend(drift_alerts)
+        
+        # 3. Concept drift (se abbiamo performance)
+        if performance_metrics:
+            for metric_name, value in performance_metrics.items():
+                self.concept_drift.update_performance(metric_name, value)
+        
+        concept_alerts = self.concept_drift.check_concept_drift()
+        all_alerts.extend(concept_alerts)
+        
+        # Salva tutti gli alert
+        self.all_alerts.extend(all_alerts)
+        
+        # Summary
+        summary = {
+            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+            "total_alerts": len(all_alerts),
+            "alerts_by_type": {},
+            "alerts_by_severity": {},
+            "data_quality_status": "pass" if not any(a.drift_type == "data_quality" for a in all_alerts) else "fail",
+            "drift_status": "stable" if not any(a.drift_type == "data_drift" for a in all_alerts) else "drift_detected",
+            "concept_drift_status": "stable" if not any(a.drift_type == "concept_drift" for a in all_alerts) else "degradation_detected",
+        }
+        
+        for alert in all_alerts:
+            summary["alerts_by_type"][alert.drift_type] = summary["alerts_by_type"].get(alert.drift_type, 0) + 1
+            summary["alerts_by_severity"][alert.severity] = summary["alerts_by_severity"].get(alert.severity, 0) + 1
+        
+        return {
+            "summary": summary,
+            "alerts": [self._alert_to_dict(a) for a in all_alerts],
+            "drift_summary": self.data_drift.get_drift_summary(),
+        }
+    
+    def _alert_to_dict(self, alert: DriftAlert) -> Dict:
+        return {
+            "timestamp": alert.timestamp.isoformat(),
+            "feature": alert.feature,
+            "type": alert.drift_type,
+            "severity": alert.severity,
+            "metric": alert.metric_value,
+            "threshold": alert.threshold,
+            "message": alert.message,
+            "details": alert.details,
+        }
+    
+    def generate_evidently_report(
+        self,
+        reference_data: pd.DataFrame,
+        current_data: pd.DataFrame,
+        output_path: str = "drift_report.html",
+    ) -> str:
+        """Genera report Evidently per drift analysis."""
+        if not HAS_EVIDENTLY:
+            raise RuntimeError("evidently non installato: pip install evidently")
+        
+        report = Report(metrics=[
+            DataDriftPreset(),
+            DataQualityPreset(),
+            TargetDriftPreset(),
+        ])
+        
+        report.run(reference_data=reference_data, current_data=current_data)
+        report.save_html(output_path)
+        
+        return output_path
+    
+    def get_monitoring_status(self) -> Dict:
+        """Stato completo monitoring."""
+        return {
+            "active": self.monitoring_active,
+            "reference_set": self.data_drift.reference_data is not None,
+            "total_alerts": len(self.all_alerts),
+            "recent_alerts_24h": len([
+                a for a in self.all_alerts 
+                if (datetime.now() - a.timestamp) < timedelta(hours=24)
+            ]),
+            "data_drift": self.data_drift.get_drift_summary(),
+            "config": {
+                "drift_threshold": self.config.drift_threshold,
+                "psi_threshold": self.config.psi_threshold,
+                "performance_threshold": self.config.performance_threshold,
+            }
+        }

+class StreamingMonitor:
+    """
+    Monitor per streaming real-time (es. tick data).
+    Usa sliding windows per drift detection online.
+    """
+    
+    def __init__(self, config: MonitoringConfig, window_size: int = 1000):
+        self.config = config
+        self.window_size = window_size
+        self.feature_buffers: Dict[str, deque] = {}
+        self.drift_detector = DataDriftDetector(config)
+        self.alert_callback: Optional[Callable[[DriftAlert], None]] = None
+    
+    def set_alert_callback(self, callback: Callable[[DriftAlert], None]):
+        """Imposta callback per alert real-time."""
+        self.alert_callback = callback
+    
+    def add_observation(self, features: Dict[str, float]):
+        """Aggiunge osservazione singola."""
+        for feature, value in features.items():
+            if feature not in self.feature_buffers:
+                self.feature_buffers[feature] = deque(maxlen=self.window_size)
+            self.feature_buffers[feature].append(value)
+    
+    def check_drift(self) -> List[DriftAlert]:
+        """Controlla drift su buffer correnti."""
+        if not self.feature_buffers:
+            return []
+        
+        # Converti buffer a DataFrame
+        current_data = pd.DataFrame({
+            k: list(v) for k, v in self.feature_buffers.items()
+        })
+        
+        # Usa primi campioni come reference se non impostato
+        if self.drift_detector.reference_data is None and len(current_data) > 100:
+            ref_size = min(500, len(current_data) // 2)
+            self.drift_detector.set_reference(current_data.iloc[:ref_size])
+            current_data = current_data.iloc[ref_size:]
+        
+        alerts = self.drift_detector.check_drift(current_data)
+        
+        # Trigger callback
+        if self.alert_callback:
+            for alert in alerts:
+                self.alert_callback(alert)
+        
+        return alerts
+
+
+# ─── FACTORY ───
+
+def create_monitor(config: Optional[MonitoringConfig] = None) -> ModelMonitor:
+    """Factory per ModelMonitor."""
+    return ModelMonitor(config)
+
+
+def create_streaming_monitor(config: Optional[MonitoringConfig] = None, window_size: int = 1000) -> StreamingMonitor:
+    """Factory per StreamingMonitor."""
+    return StreamingMonitor(config or MonitoringConfig(), window_size)

+class JARVISMonitorIntegrator:
+    """
+    Integra monitoring nel flusso JARVIS.
+    """
+    
+    def __init__(self, settings: Settings):
+        self.settings = settings
+        self.monitor = ModelMonitor()
+        self.prediction_buffer = []
+        self.target_buffer = []
+        self.feature_buffer = []
+    
+    def on_tick(self, features: Dict[str, float], prediction: float, target: float = None):
+        """Chiamato ad ogni tick."""
+        self.feature_buffer.append(features)
+        self.prediction_buffer.append(prediction)
+        if target is not None:
+            self.target_buffer.append(target)
+        
+        # Batch monitoring ogni N tick
+        if len(self.feature_buffer) >= 100:
+            self._run_monitoring()
+    
+    def _run_monitoring(self):
+        """Esegue monitoring su buffer."""
+        if len(self.feature_buffer) < 50:
+            return
+        
+        # Prepara dati
+        current_data = pd.DataFrame(self.feature_buffer[-500:])
+        predictions = np.array(self.prediction_buffer[-500:])
+        targets = np.array(self.target_buffer[-500:]) if self.target_buffer else None
+        
+        # Performance metrics
+        perf_metrics = {}
+        if targets is not None and len(targets) > 10:
+            mse = np.mean((predictions - targets) ** 2)
+            mae = np.mean(np.abs(predictions - targets))

+        for df in factor_dfs.values():

+            combined = sum(df * weights.get(name, 0) for name, df in aligned_factors.items())

+        elif method == "rank_weight":

+        total_inv = sum(inv_vols.values())

+    def _compute_forward_returns(self) -> pd.DataFrame:

+        for symbol, df in self._price_data.items():

+            returns_dict = {}
+            
+            for period in self.config.forward_returns_periods:
+                fwd_ret = close.pct_change(period).shift(-period)
+                returns_dict[period] = fwd_ret
+            
+            if returns_dict:
+                all_returns[symbol] = pd.concat(returns_dict, axis=1)
+        
+        if all_returns:
+            combined = pd.concat(all_returns, axis=1)
+            combined.columns = pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples(
+                [(symbol, period) for symbol in all_returns for period in self.config.forward_returns_periods],
+                names=["symbol", "period"]
+            )
+            return combined
+        
+        return pd.DataFrame()

+    def _prepare_factor_for_alphalens(self, factor_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
+        """Prepara factor per Alphalens (stack to long format)."""
+        # factor_df ha MultiIndex columns (factor, symbol)
+        # Alphalens vuole Series con MultiIndex (date, asset)
+        
+        stacked = factor_df.stack(level="symbol")
+        stacked.index.names = ["date", "asset"]

+    # ─── PORTFOLIO CONSTRUCTION ───
+    
+    def construct_long_short_portfolio(
+        self,
+        factor_df: pd.DataFrame,
+        forward_returns: pd.DataFrame,
+        quantile: int = 5,
+        long_quantile: int = 5,
+        short_quantile: int = 1,
+        equal_weight: bool = True,
+        max_position_size: float = 0.1,
+        neutralize_market: bool = True,
+    ) -> pd.DataFrame:
+        """
+        Costruisce portfolio long/short da factor.
+        
+        Returns DataFrame con pesi per ogni (date, asset).
+        """
+        # Allinea factor e returns
+        common_idx = factor_df.index.intersection(forward_returns.index)
+        factor = factor_df.loc[common_idx]
+        returns = forward_returns.loc[common_idx]
+        
+        weights = pd.DataFrame(index=common_idx, columns=factor.columns, dtype=float)
+        
+        for date in common_idx:
+            f = factor.loc[date].dropna()
+            r = returns.loc[date].dropna()
+            
+            common_assets = f.index.intersection(r.index)
+            if len(common_assets) < self.config.quantiles * 2:
+                continue
+            
+            f = f[common_assets]
+            r = r[common_assets]
+            
+            # Rank e quantili
+            ranks = f.rank(method="first", ascending=True)
+            n = len(f)
+            q_size = n // self.config.quantiles
+            
+            long_assets = ranks[ranks > n - q_size * (long_quantile - 1)].index
+            short_assets = ranks[ranks <= q_size * short_quantile].index
+            
+            if equal_weight:
+                if len(long_assets) > 0:
+                    weights[long_assets] = 1.0 / len(long_assets)
+                if len(short_assets) > 0:
+                    weights[short_assets] = -1.0 / len(short_assets)
+            else:
+                # Weight by factor value
+                long_sum = f[long_assets].sum()
+                short_sum = f[short_assets].sum()
+                if long_sum != 0:
+                    weights[long_assets] = f[long_assets] / long_sum
+                if short_sum != 0:
+                    weights[short_assets] = -f[short_assets] / short_sum
+            
+            # Market neutralization
+            if neutralize_market:
+                weights = weights.sub(weights.mean(axis=1), axis=0)
+            
+            # Position size limit
+            weights = weights.clip(-max_position_size, max_position_size)
+        
+        return weights
+    
+    def backtest_portfolio(
+        self,
+        weights: pd.DataFrame,
+        returns: pd.DataFrame,
+        transaction_cost: float = None,
+    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """Backtesta portfolio weights."""
+        
+        tc = transaction_cost or self.config.transaction_cost
+        
+        # Portfolio returns
+        port_returns = (weights.shift(1) * returns).sum(axis=1)
+        
+        # Transaction costs
+        weight_changes = weights.diff().abs().sum(axis=1)
+        tc_costs = weight_changes * tc
+        net_returns = port_returns - tc_costs
+        
+        # Metriche
+        equity = (1 + net_returns).cumprod()
+        
+        metrics = {
+            "total_return": equity.iloc[-1] - 1,
+            "annual_return": net_returns.mean() * 252,
+            "volatility": net_returns.std() * np.sqrt(252),
+            "sharpe": net_returns.mean() / net_returns.std() * np.sqrt(252) if net_returns.std() > 0 else 0,
+            "max_drawdown": (equity / equity.cummax() - 1).min(),
+            "turnover": weight_changes.mean(),
+            "tc_cost": tc_costs.mean(),
+        }
+        
+        return {
+            "weights": weights,
+            "gross_returns": port_returns,
+            "net_returns": net_returns,
+            "equity": equity,
+            "metrics": metrics,
+        }

+    @staticmethod
+    def black_scholes_price(
+        spot: float,
+        strike: float,
+        time_to_expiry: float,
+        rate: float,
+        vol: float,
+        option_type: str = "call",
+    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
+        """Black-Scholes pricing offline."""
+        from scipy.stats import norm
+        
+        d1 = (np.log(spot / strike) + (rate + 0.5 * vol**2) * time_to_expiry) / (vol * np.sqrt(time_to_expiry))
+        d2 = d1 - vol * np.sqrt(time_to_expiry)
+        
+        if option_type.lower() == "call":
+            price = spot * norm.cdf(d1) - strike * np.exp(-rate * time_to_expiry) * norm.cdf(d2)
+            delta = norm.cdf(d1)
+        else:
+            price = strike * np.exp(-rate * time_to_expiry) * norm.cdf(-d2) - spot * norm.cdf(-d1)
+            delta = -norm.cdf(-d1)
+        
+        gamma = norm.pdf(d1) / (spot * vol * np.sqrt(time_to_expiry))
+        vega = spot * norm.pdf(d1) * np.sqrt(time_to_expiry) / 100
+        theta = (-spot * norm.pdf(d1) * vol / (2 * np.sqrt(time_to_expiry)) 
+                 - rate * strike * np.exp(-rate * time_to_expiry) * norm.cdf(d2 if option_type == "call" else -d2)) / 365
+        rho = strike * time_to_expiry * np.exp(-rate * time_to_expiry) * norm.cdf(d2 if option_type == "call" else -d2) / 100
+        
+        return {

+            "delta": delta,
+            "gamma": gamma,
+            "vega": vega,

+    @staticmethod
+    def swap_pv01(
+        notional: float,
+        rate: float,
+        years: float,
+        frequency: int = 2,
+    ) -> float:
+        """PV01 approssimato per swap."""
+        # Approssimazione: PV01 ≈ Notional * Years * 0.0001 * (1 - rate)^Years
+        return notional * years * 0.0001 * (1 - rate) ** years
+    
+    @staticmethod
+    def bond_duration_convexity(
+        coupon: float,
+        yield_: float,
+        maturity: float,
+        frequency: int = 2,
+    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
+        """Duration e convexity obbligazione."""
+        periods = maturity * frequency
+        c = coupon / frequency
+        y = yield_ / frequency
+        
+        # Macaulay Duration
+        pv_coupons = sum((t * c) / (1 + y)**t for t in range(1, int(periods) + 1))
+        pv_principal = (periods * 100) / (1 + y)**periods
+        pv_total = sum(c / (1 + y)**t for t in range(1, int(periods) + 1)) + 100 / (1 + y)**periods
+        
+        macaulay_dur = (pv_coupons + pv_principal) / pv_total
+        modified_dur = macaulay_dur / (1 + y)
+        
+        # Convexity
+        convexity = sum(t * (t + 1) * c / (1 + y)**(t + 2) for t in range(1, int(periods) + 1))
+        convexity += periods * (periods + 1) * 100 / (1 + y)**(periods + 2)
+        convexity /= pv_total * frequency**2
+        
+        return {
+            "macaulay_duration": macaulay_dur / frequency,
+            "modified_duration": modified_dur / frequency,
+            "convexity": convexity,
+        }

+        var = GSQuantOffline.var_historical(returns, confidence)

+        horizon_days: int = 10,

+        """Calcola reward in base a config."""
+        if self.config.reward_type == "pnl":
+            reward = trade_pnl * self.config.reward_scaling
+        elif self.config.reward_type == "sharpe":
+            if len(self.equity_history) > 20:
+                returns = np.diff(self.equity_history) / self.equity_history[:-1]
+                sharpe = np.mean(returns) / (np.std(returns) + 1e-8) * np.sqrt(252)
+                reward = sharpe * self.config.reward_scaling
+            else:
+                reward = 0
+        elif self.config.reward_type == "sortino":
+            if len(self.equity_history) > 20:
+                returns = np.diff(self.equity_history) / self.equity_history[:-1]
+                downside = returns[returns < 0]
+                sortino = np.mean(returns) / (np.std(downside) + 1e-8) * np.sqrt(252)
+                reward = sortino * self.config.reward_scaling
+            else:
+                reward = 0
+        elif self.config.reward_type == "custom":
+            # Risk-adjusted custom reward
+            reward = trade_pnl * self.config.reward_scaling - drawdown * self.config.risk_penalty
+        else:
+            reward = trade_pnl * self.config.reward_scaling
+        
+        # Penalty per drawdown eccessivo
+        if drawdown > self.config.early_stop_drawdown:
+            reward -= 100
+        
+        return float(reward)
+    
+    def render(self, mode: str = "human"):
+        """Render environment."""
+        if mode == "human":
+            print(f"Step: {self.current_step} | Equity: {self.equity_history[-1]:.2f} | "
+                  f"Pos: {self.current_position} | DD: {((self.peak_equity - self.equity_history[-1]) / self.peak_equity * 100):.2f}%")
+    
+    def close(self):
+        pass
+    
+    def get_episode_stats(self) -> Dict:
+        """Statistiche episodio."""
+        if len(self.equity_history) < 2:
+            return {}
+        
+        returns = np.diff(self.equity_history) / self.equity_history[:-1]
+        
+        return {
+            "total_return": (self.equity_history[-1] - self.config.initial_cash) / self.config.initial_cash,
+            "sharpe": np.mean(returns) / (np.std(returns) + 1e-8) * np.sqrt(252),
+            "max_drawdown": max((np.maximum.accumulate(self.equity_history) - self.equity_history) / np.maximum.accumulate(self.equity_history)),
+            "n_trades": len([t for t in self.trade_history if t["action"] == "OPEN"]),
+            "win_rate": len([t for t in self.trade_history if t.get("pnl", 0) > 0]) / max(len([t for t in self.trade_history if "pnl" in t]), 1),
+            "final_equity": self.equity_history[-1],
+        }
+
+
+# ─── TRAINER ───
+
+class JARVISTrainer:
+    """
+    Trainer per modelli RL con Stable Baselines 3.
+    """
+    
+    def __init__(self, config: RLConfig, settings: Optional[Settings] = None):
+        if not HAS_SB3:
+            raise RuntimeError("stable-baselines3 non installato: pip install stable-baselines3")
+        
+        self.config = config
+        self.settings = settings
+        self.model = None
+        self.vec_env = None
+        self.eval_env = None
+    
+    def create_env(self, eval_mode: bool = False) -> gym.Env:
+        """Crea environment (con Monitor per logging)."""
+        env = JARVISEnv(self.config, self.settings)
+        if not eval_mode:
+            env = Monitor(env)
+        return env
+    
+    def create_vec_env(self, n_envs: int = 4) -> DummyVecEnv:
+        """Crea vectorized environment."""
+        def make_env():
+            return self.create_env()
+        
+        vec_env = DummyVecEnv([make_env for _ in range(n_envs)])
+        # Normalizzazione observation
+        vec_env = VecNormalize(vec_env, norm_obs=True, norm_reward=True, clip_obs=10.)
+        return vec_env
+    
+    def create_model(self):
+        """Crea modello SB3."""
+        alg_map = {
+            "PPO": PPO,
+            "SAC": SAC,
+            "DQN": DQN,
+            "A2C": A2C,
+        }
+        
+        if self.config.algorithm not in alg_map:
+            raise ValueError(f"Algoritmo {self.config.algorithm} non supportato")
+        
+        AlgClass = alg_map[self.config.algorithm]
+        
+        # Policy kwargs
+        policy_kwargs = dict(
+            net_arch=[256, 256],
+            activation_fn=torch.nn.ReLU,
+        )
+        
+        self.model = AlgClass(
+            "MlpPolicy",
+            self.vec_env,
+            learning_rate=self.config.learning_rate,
+            n_steps=self.config.n_steps if self.config.algorithm in ["PPO", "A2C"] else None,
+            batch_size=self.config.batch_size,
+            gamma=self.config.gamma,
+            gae_lambda=self.config.gae_lambda if self.config.algorithm == "PPO" else None,
+            clip_range=self.config.clip_range if self.config.algorithm == "PPO" else None,
+            ent_coef=self.config.ent_coef if self.config.algorithm in ["PPO", "SAC", "A2C"] else None,
+            vf_coef=self.config.vf_coef if self.config.algorithm in ["PPO", "A2C"] else None,
+            max_grad_norm=self.config.max_grad_norm,
+            policy_kwargs=policy_kwargs,
+            tensorboard_log=self.config.tensorboard_log,
+            verbose=self.config.verbose,
+            device="auto",
+        )
+    
+    def train(self) -> Dict:
+        """Esegue training."""
+        # Setup
+        self.vec_env = self.create_vec_env()
+        self.create_model()
+        
+        # Callbacks
+        callbacks = []
+        
+        # Eval callback
+        eval_env = self.create_vec_env(n_envs=1)
+        eval_callback = EvalCallback(
+            eval_env,
+            best_model_save_path=f"./models/{self.config.algorithm}_best",
+            log_path=f"./logs/{self.config.algorithm}_eval",
+            eval_freq=self.config.eval_freq,
+            n_eval_episodes=self.config.n_eval_episodes,
+            deterministic=self.config.deterministic_eval,
+            render=False,
+        )
+        callbacks.append(eval_callback)
+        
+        # Checkpoint callback
+        checkpoint_callback = CheckpointCallback(
+            save_freq=self.config.checkpoint_freq,
+            save_path=f"./checkpoints/{self.config.algorithm}/",
+            name_prefix="jarvis_rl",
+        )
+        callbacks.append(checkpoint_callback)
+        
+        # Custom callback per logging JARVIS
+        class JARVISCallback(BaseCallback):
+            def __init__(self, verbose=0):
+                super().__init__(verbose)
+            
+            def _on_step(self) -> bool:
+                # Log custom metrics
+                if self.n_calls % 1000 == 0:
+                    # Log equity, drawdown, etc.
+                    pass
+                return True
+        
+        callbacks.append(JARVISCallback())
+        
+        # Train
+        self.model.learn(
+            total_timesteps=self.config.total_timesteps,
+            callback=callbacks,
+            tb_log_name=f"jarvis_{self.config.algorithm}_{self.config.symbol}",
+            progress_bar=True,
+        )
+        
+        # Save final model
+        self.model.save(f"./models/jarvis_{self.config.algorithm}_{self.config.symbol}_final")
+        
+        # Save VecNormalize stats
+        self.vec_env.save(f"./models/vecnormalize_{self.config.algorithm}.pkl")
+        
+        return {
+            "model_path": f"./models/jarvis_{self.config.algorithm}_{self.config.symbol}_final",
+            "total_timesteps": self.config.total_timesteps,
+        }
+    
+    def evaluate(self, n_episodes: int = 10, deterministic: bool = True) -> Dict:
+        """Valuta modello addestrato."""
+        if self.model is None:
+            raise ValueError "Modello non addestrato"
+        
+        eval_env = JARVISEnv(self.config, self.settings)
+        eval_env = Monitor(eval_env)
+        
+        episode_rewards = []
+        episode_lengths = []
+        episode_stats = []
+        
+        for _ in range(n_episodes):
+            obs, _ = eval_env.reset()
+            done = False
+            episode_reward = 0
+            episode_length = 0
+            
+            while not done:
+                action, _ = self.model.predict(obs, deterministic=deterministic)
+                obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info = eval_env.step(action)
+                episode_reward += reward
+                episode_length += 1
+                done = terminated or truncated
+            
+            episode_rewards.append(episode_reward)
+            episode_lengths.append(episode_length)
+            episode_stats.append(eval_env.get_episode_stats())
+        
+        return {
+            "mean_reward": np.mean(episode_rewards),
+            "std_reward": np.std(episode_rewards),
+            "mean_length": np.mean(episode_lengths),
+            "episode_stats": episode_stats,
+        }
+
+
+# ─── TRADEMASTER INTEGRATION ───
+
+class TradeMasterAdapter:
+    """
+    Adapter per TradeMaster (NTU) - piattaforma RL quantitative.
+    """
+    
+    def __init__(self, config: RLConfig):
+        if not HAS_TRADEMASTER:
+            raise RuntimeError("TradeMaster non installato")
+        
+        self.config = config
+        self.engine = None
+    
+    def setup_environment(self):
+        """Configura ambiente TradeMaster."""
+        # TradeMaster usa config YAML
+        import yaml
+        
+        config = {
+            "env": {
+                "name": "JARVIS-Trading",
+                "data_source": "mt5",
+                "symbol": self.config.symbol,
+                "timeframe": self.config.timeframe,
+                "start_date": self.config.start_date,
+                "end_date": self.config.end_date,
+                "initial_cash": self.config.initial_cash,
+                "commission": self.config.transaction_cost,
+            },
+            "agent": {
+                "algorithm": self.config.algorithm.lower(),
+                "network": "mlp",
+                "hidden_dims": [256, 256],
+            },
+            "training": {
+                "total_timesteps": self.config.total_timesteps,
+                "learning_rate": self.config.learning_rate,
+                "batch_size": self.config.batch_size,
+                "gamma": self.config.gamma,
+            }
+        }
+        
+        with open("trademaster_config.yaml", "w") as f:
+            yaml.dump(config, f)
+        
+        return config
+    
+    def run_training(self):
+        """Esegue training con TradeMaster."""
+        # TradeMaster CLI
+        import subprocess
+        result = subprocess.run([
+            "trademaster", "train",
+            "--config", "trademaster_config.yaml",
+            "--device", "auto"
+        ], capture_output=True, text=True)
+        
+        return result
+    
+    def run_backtest(self):
+        """Esegue backtest con agent addestrato."""
+        import subprocess
+        result = subprocess.run([
+            "trademaster", "backtest",
+            "--model", f"./models/jarvis_{self.config.algorithm}_best",
+            "--data", self.config.symbol,
+        ], capture_output=True, text=True)
+        
+        return result
+
+
+# ─── TRADINGGYM INTEGRATION ───
+
+class TradingGymAdapter:
+    """
+    Adapter per TradingGym - OpenAI Gym per trading RL.
+    """
+    
+    def __init__(self, config: RLConfig):
+        if not HAS_GYM:
+            raise RuntimeError("gymnasium non installato")
+        
+        self.config = config
+    
+    def create_env(self):
+        """Crea env TradingGym-style."""
+        # TradingGym usa config diverso
+        # Qui adattiamo JARVISEnv per compatibilità
+        return JARVISEnv(self.config)
+
+
+# ─── FACTORY FUNCTIONS ───
+
+def create_rl_config(
+    symbol: str = "XAUUSD",
+    algorithm: str = "PPO",
+    **kwargs
+) -> RLConfig:

+    return RLConfig(
+        symbol=symbol,
+        algorithm=algorithm,
+        **kwargs
+    )
+
+
+def train_rl_agent(
+    symbol: str = "XAUUSD",
+    algorithm: str = "PPO",
+    timesteps: int = 100000,
+    **kwargs
+) -> Dict:
+    """Entry point per training RL."""
+    config = RLConfig(
+        symbol=symbol,
+        algorithm=algorithm,
+        total_timesteps=timesteps,
+        **kwargs
+    )
+    
+    trainer = JARVISTrainer(config)

+
+
+def evaluate_rl_agent(

+    algorithm: str = "PPO",
+    symbol: str = "XAUUSD",
+    n_episodes: int = 10,
+    **kwargs
+) -> Dict:
+    """Valuta modello addestrato."""
+    config = RLConfig(
+        symbol=symbol,
+        algorithm=algorithm,
+        **kwargs
+    )

+    trainer = JARVISTrainer(config)

+
+# ─── TRADEMASTER ENV WRAPPER ───

"""
JARVIS v20 - AKShare Financial Data Feed
=========================================

Feed dati universale per 100+ fonti finanziarie via AKShare:
- Stock Cina (A-share, HK, US-listed Chinese)
- Futures (CFFEX, SHFE, DCE, CZCE, INE)
- Options (SSE, SZSE)
- Macro data (CPI, PPI, GDP, PMI, interest rates, FX reserves)
- Funds (ETF, mutual funds, hedge funds)
- Bonds (government, corporate, convertible)
- Forex (CNY pairs, major crosses)
- Crypto (via AKShare crypto interfaces)
- Alternative data (weather, satellite, shipping indices)

Install: pip install akshare
Docs: https://akshare.akfamily.xyz
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Union

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

try:
    import akshare as ak
    HAS_AKSHARE = True
except ImportError:
    HAS_AKSHARE = False
    ak = None

from .base import Candles, DataFeed, FeedError, Quote
from .registry import FeedRegistry

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class AKShareFeedConfig:
    """Configurazione feed AKShare."""
    # Symbol mapping
    symbol: str = "000001"  # Default: 平安银行
    market: str = "stock_cn"  # stock_cn, stock_hk, stock_us, futures, options, macro, fund, bond, forex, crypto
    
    # Timeframe
    period: str = "daily"  # daily, weekly, monthly, 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 60m
    adjust: str = "qfq"  # qfq (forward), hfq (backward), "" (none)
    
    # Date range
    start_date: Optional[str] = None  # "20230101"
    end_date: Optional[str] = None    # "20240101"
    
    # Futures specific
    futures_exchange: str = "SHFE"  # SHFE, DCE, CZCE, CFFEX, INE
    futures_contract: str = "主力合约"  # 主力合约, 指数合约, specific contract
    
    # Macro specific
    macro_indicator: str = "cpi"  # cpi, ppi, gdp, pmi, m2, interest_rate, fx_reserves
    
    # Cache
    cache_minutes: int = 60
    use_cache: bool = True


class AKShareFeed(DataFeed):
    """
    Feed dati AKShare per mercati finanziari globali (focus Cina).
    
    Caratteristiche:
    - 100+ fonti dati unificate
    - Nessuna API key richiesta
    - Dati storici + real-time (dove disponibile)
    - Cache intelligente
    - Mapping simboli automatico
    """
    
    # Mapping mercati AKShare
    MARKET_METHODS = {
        # Stocks
        "stock_cn": {
            "hist": "stock_zh_a_hist",
            "spot": "stock_zh_a_spot_em",
            "realtime": "stock_zh_a_spot_em",
        },
        "stock_hk": {
            "hist": "stock_hk_hist",
            "spot": "stock_hk_spot",
        },
        "stock_us": {
            "hist": "stock_us_hist",
            "spot": "stock_us_spot",
        },
        # Futures
        "futures": {
            "hist": "futures_main_sina",  # 主力合约
            "spot": "futures_zh_spot",
            "realtime": "futures_zh_realtime",
        },
        # Options
        "options": {
            "hist": "option_sse_hist",
            "spot": "option_sse_spot",
        },
        # Macro
        "macro": {
            "cpi": "macro_china_cpi",
            "ppi": "macro_china_ppi",
            "gdp": "macro_china_gdp",
            "pmi": "macro_china_pmi",
            "m2": "macro_china_m2",
            "interest_rate": "macro_china_interest_rate",
            "fx_reserves": "macro_china_fx_reserves",
        },
        # Funds
        "fund": {
            "etf_hist": "fund_etf_hist_sina",
            "etf_spot": "fund_etf_spot_em",
            "mf_hist": "fund_open_fund_hist_em",
        },
        # Bonds
        "bond": {
            "gov_hist": "bond_zh_hist",
            "corp_hist": "bond_zh_cov_hist",
        },
        # Forex
        "forex": {
            "spot": "fx_spot_quote",
            "hist": "fx_hist_quote",
        },
        # Crypto
        "crypto": {
            "spot": "crypto_spot_price",
            "hist": "crypto_hist_price",
        },
    }
    
    def __init__(self, config: AKShareFeedConfig):
        if not HAS_AKSHARE:
            raise FeedError("AKShare non installato: pip install akshare")
        
        self.config = config
        self._connected = False
        self._last_quote: Optional[Quote] = None
        self._candle_cache: Dict[str, Candles] = {}
        self._cache_timestamps: Dict[str, float] = {}
        self._symbol_map: Dict[str, str] = {}  # internal -> akshare symbol
        
        # Normalizza symbol
        self._symbol_internal = config.symbol.upper().replace(".", "").replace("/", "")
    
    @property
    def symbol(self) -> str:
        return self._symbol_internal
    
    @property
    def is_connected(self) -> bool:
        return self._connected
    
    def connect(self) -> None:
        """Verifica connessione AKShare (test query)."""
        try:
            # Test con una query leggera
            test_method = self._get_method("spot")
            if test_method:
                _ = test_method()
            self._connected = True
            logger.info(f"AKShare Feed connesso: {self.config.market} - {self.config.symbol}")
        except Exception as e:
            raise FeedError(f"Connessione AKShare fallita: {e}")
    
    def close(self) -> None:
        self._connected = False
        self._candle_cache.clear()
        self._cache_timestamps.clear()
        logger.info("AKShare Feed disconnesso")
    
    def reconnect(self) -> bool:
        try:
            self.close()
            time.sleep(0.5)
            self.connect()
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Riconnessione AKShare fallita: {e}")
            return False
    
    def select(self, symbol: str) -> None:
        """Cambia simbolo."""
        self.config.symbol = symbol
        self._symbol_internal = symbol.upper().replace(".", "").replace("/", "")
        self._candle_cache.clear()
        self._cache_timestamps.clear()
        logger.info(f"AKShare Feed simbolo cambiato: {self.config.symbol}")
    
    def _get_method(self, method_type: str):
        """Ritorna funzione AKShare per mercato/tipo."""
        market_config = self.MARKET_METHODS.get(self.config.market, {})
        method_name = market_config.get(method_type)
        if not method_name:
            return None
        return getattr(ak, method_name, None)
    
    def _get_akshare_symbol(self) -> str:
        """Converte symbol interno in formato AKShare."""
        # Già mappato?
        if self.config.symbol in self._symbol_map:
            return self._symbol_map[self.config.symbol]
        
        sym = self.config.symbol
        
        # Mapping comuni
        if self.config.market == "stock_cn":
            # A-share: 600000, 000001, 300001, 688001
            if sym.isdigit() and len(sym) == 6:
                return sym
            # Prova a cercare per nome
            try:
                spot = ak.stock_zh_a_spot_em()
                match = spot[spot['名称'].str.contains(sym, case=False, na=False)]
                if not match.empty:
                    return match.iloc[0]['代码']
            except Exception:
                pass
        
        elif self.config.market == "stock_hk":
            # HK: 00700, 09988
            if sym.isdigit() and len(sym) <= 5:
                return sym.zfill(5)
        
        elif self.config.market == "futures":
            # Futures: RB2401, CU2401, 主力合约
            return sym
        
        return sym
    
    def _is_cache_valid(self, cache_key: str) -> bool:
        if not self.config.use_cache:
            return False
        ts = self._cache_timestamps.get(cache_key, 0)
        return (time.time() - ts) < (self.config.cache_minutes * 60)
    
    def quote(self) -> Quote:
        """Quote corrente (spot/realtime)."""
        if not self._connected:
            raise FeedError("Feed non connesso")
        
        cache_key = f"quote_{self.config.symbol}"
        if self._is_cache_valid(cache_key) and self._last_quote:
            return self._last_quote
        
        try:
            ak_sym = self._get_akshare_symbol()
            method = self._get_method("realtime") or self._get_method("spot")
            
            if not method:
                raise FeedError(f"Metodo quote non disponibile per {self.config.market}")
            
            # Chiama metodo AKShare appropriato
            if self.config.market == "stock_cn":
                df = method()
                row = df[df['代码'] == ak_sym]
                if row.empty:
                    raise FeedError(f"Simbolo {ak_sym} non trovato")
                row = row.iloc[0]
                
                q = Quote(
                    symbol=self._symbol_internal,
                    bid=float(row.get('买一价', row.get('最新价', 0))),
                    ask=float(row.get('卖一价', row.get('最新价', 0))),
                    spread=0.0,
                    digits=2,
                    timestamp=datetime.now(),
                )
            
            elif self.config.market == "futures":
                df = method()
                row = df[df['symbol'] == ak_sym]
                if row.empty:
                    raise FeedError(f"Futures {ak_sym} non trovato")
                row = row.iloc[0]
                
                q = Quote(
                    symbol=self._symbol_internal,
                    bid=float(row.get('bid_price', row.get('last_price', 0))),
                    ask=float(row.get('ask_price', row.get('last_price', 0))),
                    spread=float(row.get('ask_price', 0)) - float(row.get('bid_price', 0)),
                    digits=2,
                    timestamp=datetime.now(),
                )
            
            else:
                # Fallback generico
                df = method()
                if hasattr(df, 'iloc') and len(df) > 0:
                    row = df.iloc[0]
                    price = float(row.get('price', row.get('close', row.get('最新价', 0))))
                    q = Quote(
                        symbol=self._symbol_internal,
                        bid=price,
                        ask=price,
                        spread=0.0,
                        digits=2,
                        timestamp=datetime.now(),
                    )
                else:
                    raise FeedError("Dati quote non disponibili")
            
            self._last_quote = q
            self._cache_timestamps[cache_key] = time.time()
            return q
            
        except FeedError:
            raise
        except Exception as e:
            raise FeedError(f"Errore quote AKShare: {e}")
    
    def candles(self, timeframe: str, count: int) -> Optional[Candles]:
        """Candles OHLCV storici."""
        if not self._connected:
            raise FeedError("Feed non connesso")
        
        cache_key = f"candles_{timeframe}_{count}_{self.config.symbol}"
        if self._is_cache_valid(cache_key) and cache_key in self._candle_cache:
            return self._candle_cache[cache_key]
        
        try:
            ak_sym = self._get_akshare_symbol()
            method = self._get_method("hist")
            
            if not method:
                raise FeedError(f"Metodo storico non disponibile per {self.config.market}")
            
            # Parametri per chiamata storica
            kwargs = {"symbol": ak_sym}
            
            # Period mapping
            period_map = {
                "1m": "1m", "5m": "5m", "15m": "15m", "30m": "30m", "60m": "60m",
                "M1": "1m", "M5": "5m", "M15": "15m", "M30": "30m", "H1": "60m",
                "D1": "daily", "W1": "weekly", "M1": "monthly",
                "daily": "daily", "weekly": "weekly", "monthly": "monthly",
            }
            kwargs["period"] = period_map.get(timeframe.lower(), self.config.period)
            
            if self.config.adjust:
                kwargs["adjust"] = self.config.adjust
            
            if self.config.start_date:
                kwargs["start_date"] = self.config.start_date
            if self.config.end_date:
                kwargs["end_date"] = self.config.end_date
            
            # Futures specific
            if self.config.market == "futures":
                kwargs["exchange"] = self.config.futures_exchange
                kwargs["contract"] = self.config.futures_contract
            
            df = method(**kwargs)
            
            if df is None or len(df) == 0:
                return None
            
            # Standardizza colonne
            df = self._standardize_ohlcv(df)
            
            # Prendi ultime 'count' barre
            if len(df) > count:
                df = df.tail(count)
            
            candles = Candles(
                time=df.index.view(np.int64) // 10**9,  # ns to seconds
                open=df["Open"].values,
                high=df["High"].values,
                low=df["Low"].values,
                close=df["Close"].values,
                volume=df["Volume"].values,
                timestamp=datetime.now()
            )
            
            self._candle_cache[cache_key] = candles
            self._cache_timestamps[cache_key] = time.time()
            return candles
            
        except FeedError:
            raise
        except Exception as e:
            raise FeedError(f"Errore candles AKShare: {e}")
    
    def _standardize_ohlcv(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Standardizza colonne DataFrame AKShare in OHLCV."""
        # Mapping colonne comuni
        col_map = {
            # Stock CN
            "开盘": "Open", "收盘": "Close", "最高": "High", "最低": "Low", "成交量": "Volume",
            "open": "Open", "close": "Close", "high": "High", "low": "Low", "volume": "Volume",
            # Futures
            "open_price": "Open", "close_price": "Close", "high_price": "High", 
            "low_price": "Low", "volume": "Volume", "hold_volume": "OpenInterest",
            # Generic
            "日期": "Date", "date": "Date", "时间": "Datetime", "timestamp": "Datetime",
        }
        
        df = df.rename(columns={k: v for k, v in col_map.items() if k in df.columns})
        
        # Assicura colonne richieste
        required = ["Open", "High", "Low", "Close", "Volume"]
        for col in required:
            if col not in df.columns:
                if col == "Volume":
                    df[col] = 0
                else:
                    df[col] = df.get("Close", 0)
        
        # Parse datetime index
        if "Date" in df.columns:
            df["Date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["Date"])
            df.set_index("Date", inplace=True)
        elif "Datetime" in df.columns:
            df["Datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["Datetime"])
            df.set_index("Datetime", inplace=True)
        elif not isinstance(df.index, pd.DatetimeIndex):
            # Prova a creare index da prime colonne
            try:
                df.index = pd.to_datetime(df.iloc[:, 0])
            except Exception:
                pass
        
        # Assicura index datetime
        if not isinstance(df.index, pd.DatetimeIndex):
            df.index = pd.RangeIndex(len(df))
        
        return df[required]
    
    def fetch_historical(
        self,
        timeframe: str,
        start: datetime,
        end: datetime,
        batch_size: int = 5000
    ) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Scarica storico completo per backtest (con paginazione se necessario)."""
        self.config.start_date = start.strftime("%Y%m%d")
        self.config.end_date = end.strftime("%Y%m%d")
        
        candles = self.candles(timeframe, batch_size * 10)  # Large count
        if candles is None:
            return pd.DataFrame()
        
        df = pd.DataFrame({
            "Open": candles.open,
            "High": candles.high,
            "Low": candles.low,
            "Close": candles.close,
            "Volume": candles.volume,
        }, index=pd.to_datetime(candles.time, unit="s", utc=True))
        
        return df
    
    # ─── METODI SPECIALIZZATI PER MACRO/ALT DATA ───
    
    def get_macro_data(self, indicator: str = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Ottiene dati macroeconomici cinesi."""
        if self.config.market != "macro":
            raise FeedError("Mercato non macro")
        
        indicator = indicator or self.config.macro_indicator
        method_name = self.MARKET_METHODS["macro"].get(indicator)
        
        if not method_name:
            raise FeedError(f"Indicatore macro {indicator} non supportato")
        
        method = getattr(ak, method_name, None)
        if not method:
            raise FeedError(f"Metodo AKShare {method_name} non trovato")
        
        try:
            df = method()
            return df
        except Exception as e:
            raise FeedError(f"Errore macro data: {e}")
    
    def get_fund_data(self, fund_type: str = "etf") -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Ottiene dati fondi/ETF."""
        if self.config.market != "fund":
            raise FeedError("Mercato non fund")
        
        method_name = self.MARKET_METHODS["fund"].get(f"{fund_type}_hist")
        method = getattr(ak, method_name, None)
        
        if not method:
            raise FeedError(f"Metodo fund {fund_type} non supportato")
        
        return method(symbol=self.config.symbol)
    
    def get_bond_data(self, bond_type: str = "gov") -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Ottiene dati obbligazionari."""
        if self.config.market != "bond":
            raise FeedError("Mercato non bond")
        
        method_name = self.MARKET_METHODS["bond"].get(f"{bond_type}_hist")
        method = getattr(ak, method_name, None)
        
        if not method:
            raise FeedError(f"Metodo bond {bond_type} non supportato")
        
        return method(symbol=self.config.symbol)
    
    def search_symbols(self, query: str, market: str = None) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
        """Cerca simboli per nome/codice."""
        market = market or self.config.market
        results = []
        
        try:
            if market == "stock_cn":
                df = ak.stock_zh_a_spot_em()
                mask = df['名称'].str.contains(query, case=False, na=False) | \
                       df['代码'].str.contains(query, case=False, na=False)
                for _, row in df[mask].head(20).iterrows():
                    results.append({"symbol": row['代码'], "name": row['名称']})
            
            elif market == "stock_hk":
                df = ak.stock_hk_spot()
                mask = df['name'].str.contains(query, case=False, na=False) | \
                       df['symbol'].str.contains(query, case=False, na=False)
                for _, row in df[mask].head(20).iterrows():
                    results.append({"symbol": row['symbol'], "name": row['name']})
            
            elif market == "futures":
                df = ak.futures_zh_spot()
                mask = df['symbol'].str.contains(query, case=False, na=False) | \
                       df['name'].str.contains(query, case=False, na=False)
                for _, row in df[mask].head(20).iterrows():
                    results.append({"symbol": row['symbol'], "name": row['name']})
        
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Ricerca simboli fallita: {e}")
        
        return results


# ─── REGISTRY INTEGRATION ───

def create_akshare_feed(symbol: str, **kwargs) -> AKShareFeed:
    """Factory per FeedRegistry."""
    market = kwargs.get("market", "stock_cn")
    
    config = AKShareFeedConfig(
        symbol=symbol,
        market=market,
        period=kwargs.get("period", "daily"),
        adjust=kwargs.get("adjust", "qfq"),
        start_date=kwargs.get("start_date"),
        end_date=kwargs.get("end_date"),
        futures_exchange=kwargs.get("futures_exchange", "SHFE"),
        futures_contract=kwargs.get("futures_contract", "主力合约"),
        macro_indicator=kwargs.get("macro_indicator", "cpi"),
        cache_minutes=kwargs.get("cache_minutes", 60),
        use_cache=kwargs.get("use_cache", True),
    )
    
    return AKShareFeed(config)


# Registra nel registry
FeedRegistry.register("akshare", create_akshare_feed)
FeedRegistry.register("akshare_cn", lambda s, **k: create_akshare_feed(s, market="stock_cn", **k))
FeedRegistry.register("akshare_hk", lambda s, **k: create_akshare_feed(s, market="stock_hk", **k))
FeedRegistry.register("akshare_futures", lambda s, **k: create_akshare_feed(s, market="futures", **k))
FeedRegistry.register("akshare_macro", lambda s, **k: create_akshare_feed(s, market="macro", **k))
FeedRegistry.register("akshare_fund", lambda s, **k: create_akshare_feed(s, market="fund", **k))
FeedRegistry.register("akshare_bond", lambda s, **k: create_akshare_feed(s, market="bond", **k))
FeedRegistry.register("akshare_forex", lambda s, **k: create_akshare_feed(s, market="forex", **k))


# ─── EXAMPLE USAGE ───

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import logging
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
    
    # Test Stock CN
    config = AKShareFeedConfig(symbol="000001", market="stock_cn", period="daily")
    feed = AKShareFeed(config)
    feed.connect()
    
    q = feed.quote()
    print(f"Quote: {q.bid} / {q.ask}")
    
    candles = feed.candles("daily", 100)
    if candles:
        print(f"Candles: {len(candles.close)} bars, last close: {candles.close[-1]:.2f}")
    
    # Test Macro
    macro_config = AKShareFeedConfig(symbol="", market="macro", macro_indicator="cpi")
    macro_feed = AKShareFeed(macro_config)
    macro_feed.connect()
    cpi_data = macro_feed.get_macro_data("cpi")
    print(f"CPI data shape: {cpi_data.shape}")
    print(cpi_data.head())
    
    # Search
    symbols = feed.search_symbols("平安")
    print(f"Search results: {symbols[:5]}")
    
    feed.close()
